outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of dissected small intestine, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B is a set of histology micrographs (H&E staining), not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot (top), which is exempt since it already conveys distribution, and a 3D bar chart (bottom) showing mean polyp numbers per mouse across genotypes and diameter bins (n=8-18 per genotype). The bar chart displays only aggregated bar heights with no overlaid individual data points from each mouse, so it fails the check.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E includes immunoblots and a bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 (normalized values with error bars), but no individual data points from replicate experiments are overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs; not a plot, so the check does not apply.

Panel G includes immunoblots/zymography and a 'Relative expression' bar chart (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance asterisks, but no individual data points are shown for the underlying replicate measurements.
